text: Understanding databases is essential for managing information effectively. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables, which organise information into rows and columns. To retrieve or change data, you use queries written in a language like SQL. Good data modeling helps you plan how tables connect before you build them. Indexes are another useful tool—they speed up searches, especially in large tables. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, are more flexible and suit unstructured data. Choosing the right type depends on your project's needs.
